title: Amazing app
body:
The concept behind Finch is fantastic, from having a completely free option - even no adds -, a paid version that has the possibility to help others who can’t afford it, and with all the updates that keep happening. Sometimes there are some bugs when a new update is released, but (and this is the important part!) the team provides very quickly new updates with bug fix (p.e., I noticed a small bug, came here and noticed that in 3h the bug was already corrected and a new release available…!, that is incredible work!) and has great customer service as well.
Besides all of that technical support… what a difference Finch has brought to my mental and overall health. For free. With nothing required in return. In today’s world, where only money is considered valuable, finding a gem and truly humanitarian program is a treasure I personally value greatly and keep speaking about it to friends, family and even health care professionals.
Sorry about the monumental rant, but I just wanted to say a big “thank you” to everyone involved ❤️

title: this app has heart in every detail 💖
body:
my sister mentioned the app after reading it helped with managing adhd… it did not disappoint! the team who developed and add on to this are absolute angels. the attention to detail is endearing, really - just that alone can make you feel seen and loved - the app is also recommended for depression, anxiety, autism, ocd, and I gotta say they hit out of the park giving you options to rant, unload, schedule, analyze, plan, and lovely techniques (mantras and exercices) to help you cope. cannot recommend it enough! ALSO, very creative and cuteee dialogues, scenarios, outfits and destinations!
thank you and kuddos to the Finch team 💕
author: Vaniimela

title: Significantly helped my mental health
body:
I just want to thank the whole finch team for the amazing work they have done. This app is amazing for connecting with friends, keep track of your goals and “to dos”, process feelings and thoughts, and going through unpleasant episodes, like panic attacks. 

The only tiny detail I’d change is to make the free form reflection and the first aid kit more accessible. Maybe in the upper right corner of the Home Screen, next to the feelings log, since those are two amazing tools I personally use all the time. 

Apart from that, Finch is perfect and I believe everyone could benefit from using it. It’s difficult to believe that such a great app is free. Thanks for everything and keep up the amazing work <3
